description: The specified equality-only sentence \(\exists x\exists y\,(x\ne y)\) holds in a structure exactly when its domain contains two distinct elements.
signature:
Lemmatheca.Entry.CraigInterpolation.twoObjects_realize.{u, v, w} {L : FirstOrder.Language} (M : Type w)
  [L.Structure M] : M ⊨ Lemmatheca.Entry.CraigInterpolation.twoObjects ↔ ∃ x y, x ≠ y
